bullets: • Validate JSON structure before submission; reject malformed or incomplete responses.
• Include complete file content for all new files referenced in patches.
• Verify all patch file references exist with corresponding diff content.
• Detect and remove content exceeding JSON closing brace position.
• Reject patches referencing undefined files; require inline implementations.
• Implement new files atomically within single patch submission.
• Synchronize version numbers across all modified files and changelog entries.
• Validate CSS changes against sprint baseline standards; flag deviations.
